comment: docs/p4_hitrate.md §1: chat-like prompts back to back in one serve process, sampled (T 1.0, top_p 0.95, fixed seeds so every run emits the same tokens). Two follow-ups reuse the KV state; the resets drop only the context, never the expert cache.

turns.label: zh essay
turns.user: 请写一篇三百字左右的短文，谈谈城市里的夜跑为什么越来越流行，以及夜跑时需要注意的安全问题。

turns.label: zh follow-up
turns.user: 把上面的短文压缩成五条要点，每条不超过二十个字。

turns.label: en explain
turns.user: Explain to a curious high-school student how a refrigerator moves heat from the inside to the outside. Use one everyday analogy and keep it under 300 words.

turns.label: en follow-up
turns.user: Now explain why a refrigerator with its door left open makes the kitchen warmer, not cooler.

turns.label: code
turns.user: Write a Python function `merge_intervals(intervals)` that merges overlapping closed intervals given as a list of (start, end) tuples. Include type hints, a docstring, handle an empty list, and add three small doctest examples. Then explain its time complexity in two sentences.

turns.label: zh travel
turns.user: 我下个月想去杭州玩三天，喜欢自然风景和本地小吃，不太想去人太多的地方。请帮我排一个行程，每天分上午、下午、晚上。

turns.label: en email
turns.user: Draft a polite email to my landlord explaining that the kitchen sink has been leaking for a week, asking for a repair visit this Friday or Saturday, and mentioning that I can send photos.

turns.label: zh math
turns.user: 一个水池有进水管和出水管。单开进水管6小时注满，单开出水管8小时放空。如果两管同时打开，空池多久能注满？请一步一步说明。
